source_evidence:
PLAYER EXACT "Yes I would like to see and touch the heart again" at Nightglass Hall Day290~08:00 following independent Lord Severin's standing invitation for an optional SUPERVISED VIEWING of the ORIGINAL dark SILVER-VEINED HEART in his Nightglass reliquary (same original visited during earlier Hall visit; previous subjective words "My child" and Silver Court signet event accepted in older canon, not repeated here). This user authorizes both close visual inspection and physical touch, NOT removal of the item, claim of ownership, use of psionics/spells, a blood offering, attempting activation, signing any further oath, or saying what V feels/believes. Source prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md and prep/dm-only/long-arc-two-antagonists-dm-only.md explicitly preserve heart's unresolved actual maker, function, speaker, 'anchor' meaning and father's fate. Do not fabricate a supernatural trigger, new canon heartbeat/magic power, independent genealogical proof, or repeat previous voice/cutscene just because touching occurs.
DAY290 ~08:05 Lord Severin as current independent owner/custodian of safeguarded Nightglass Hall reliquary personally consents to touching original heart under HIS SUPERVISION, provided it stays within reliquary and remains in his custody; this conditional physical consent is reasonable in light of previous personal visitation, active prospective three-house friendship, signed legitimate research funding and source comparison. Edric attends with prior lawful paper tracing and heart recovery notes, Mara/Cirren/Fenar independently accompany by normal Hall hospitality, no required social roll, guard alarm, fee or false arcane detection. Lord walks party from breakfast through quiet older Hall hallway to private reliquary chamber, uses his own existing keys for a fortified dark-iron door and protective heart enclosure; those are ordinary dressing and not a newly invented magical lock/mechanical dungeon. The heart remains where last observed in his custody, dark exterior with silver branching veins visible as existing canonical appearance, not declared actual anatomical living heart/stone material/known manufacture. At~08:20 V approaches under express permission and places fingers onto its cool solid surface. Silver veins reflect lamp light. For initial several seconds, V observes NO NEW AUDIBLE VOICE, NO NEW VISION and no Silver Court signet appears anew; earlier subjective memory of "My child" is recalled as past knowledge only. There is no action/check/cost/spell/attack/item power or soul/lineage authentication, neither automatic incapacity nor damage. User controls whether to maintain contact, examine a vein/physical shape with deliberate Investigation, speak a name, withdraw or attempt a further specific action next; no unchosen significant step. Mara physically holds up Edric's previously prepared documentary CARRIER-MARK tracing near open enclosure WITHOUT touching or moving the heart, comments about knowledge gap, Lord acknowledges earlier unexplained encounter and requests V report only what V actually experiences; user not scripted to answer. Cirren and Fenar observe with independent caution and do not spend any resources. No evidence that carrier's wrapping mark is engraved directly on heart; no claim of confirmed match beyond prior source comparison.
Time progressed from D290~08:00 breakfast to D290~08:20 chamber, no new night, short/long rest or travel, no outside correspondence release/receipt beyond previously accepted Day290 dawn Nightglass house runner physically toward Eastwatch with two PRIORITY PIGEON-POST FORWARDING instructions (Orsaven field-book copy request, Elara nonbinding three-House proposal); no carrier pigeon actual flight verified yet, no Lady Elara agreement or map reply. House Severin prospective three-House allied recognition still only in-principle; no fealty, property or additional political consent from Elara.

V purse429gp1sp6cp, rations21 person-day/feed28 animal-day stock, sealed Pixie Dust1, LongRest new0/6 following completed full rest dawn290. Original Station Kestrel evidence V holds still undisclosed to Lord/Edric, Mara Neri notes and Nightglass comparison notes, Fenar six sealed reagent vials + silver precision tool, Cirren signed Day233 private Rethwyn Vaishnavi compact original.
